messages:
mira: OrchidAI disputed their May invoice — they claim a ~880k embed overcharge from 2025-05-15 09:10-09:20 UTC. They say their SDK retried because our rate-limiter returned 429s, but they only expect billable on accepted unique vectors. Can we triage?
sam: do we have the ingest window and a quick dedupe? any sign of dupes coming from retry-queue vs direct ingest?
mira: query I ran: 
```
select event_time, client_id, embed_count, path, payload_id from embed_ingest where client_id='orchidai' and event_time between '2025-05-15 09:10' and '2025-05-15 09:20' order by event_time limit 50;
```
sample rows:
"2025-05-15T09:10:02Z orchidai 256 api-gateway p-9a7f"
"2025-05-15T09:10:02Z orchidai 256 retry-queue p-9a7f"
"2025-05-15T09:10:03Z orchidai 256 api-gateway p-9a7f"
mira: totals in window: raw accepted events = 980,450. After sha256(payload) dedupe unique vectors = 98,045. Duplicates = 882,405.
billing-bot: Alert: embed-dup-detect triggered for orchidai (conf:0.88). Auto-ticket BILL-1214 created.
devon: unit price per contract = $0.0002. Preliminary credit = 882,405 * 0.0002 = $176.481 -> suggest $176.48 or round to $176.50.
sam: need to check ownership: was retry caused by our rate-limiter returning 429 (client retried) or did our gateway re-forward accepted messages to retry-queue?
mira: logs show series of 429s from rate-limiter between 09:09:58 -> 09:10:05. SDK retried with exponential backoff, but our retry-queue also re-enqueued some in-flight messages when gateway timed out to backend. So both sides retried.
devon: billing policy: we don't charge duplicates that are identical and accepted multiple times. But we also usually don't credit if customer caused retries via aggressive retry logic unless the platform accepted duplicates. Historically we credit accepted duplicates to avoid churn.
lisa: can you assemble a CREDIT-REQ with CSV mapping payload_id -> counts and samples? I'll do spot-check and approve if duplicates are exact. Also include the rate-limiter metric series.
mira: filing CREDIT-REQ-721 with CSV, sample payload_ids, dedupe output, and rate-limiter trace. Tagging ops and eng.
ops-bot: (system) Noted: rate-limiter saw a short-lived spike at 2025-05-15T09:09:58Z causing 429s; retry-queue processed 1,200k enqueues during the ten-minute run.
sam: proposal: issue full credit of $176.50 to OrchidAI and treat as platform-accepted duplicate. Also ask eng to add a guard to reject re-enqueued identical payloads from retry-queue if already accepted within 10s.
lisa: spot-checked 30 samples from CSV: identical payloads across repeated accept events. Approve $176.50 credit. :+1:
mira: thanks — will issue adjustment and customer note (ETA 48 hrs). Action items: ENG-RUNTIME owner=devon to add retry-queue dedupe guard (10s), DEVEX to publish SDK guidance (owner=sam), PM to add metric alert to rate-limiter spikes. Closing when credit posted. :white_check_mark:
